evidence: The tungsten ALD sequence was typically WF 6/N2/2%SiH4/N2 ¼ 1/30/60/30 s, although saturated growth could also be achieved using shorter SiH 4 exposure times. The amount of SiH 4 delivered to the chamber was metered using a needle valve, so the silane exposure could be adjusted by either changing the silane dose time or by adjusting the associated needle valve to achieve the desired silane pressure.
